Direction input repeats on a byte timer; A checks the selected price and mode restrictions before granting health, timed effects or a life. units.name: SoundTickVector
units.summary: Entry trampoline into the per-frame sound sequencer.

units.name: SoundRequestVector
units.summary: Entry trampoline for sound selection with temporary request mode.

units.name: SoundMultiply8
units.summary: Multiply the byte in sound scratch C1 by C4 using eight shift/add steps; the high and low result occupy C1:C2. Scratch is shared with sound pointers.

units.name: SoundInlineDispatch
units.summary: A selects a little-endian target from words immediately after the caller return address. Pops that return address and tail-jumps through C1:C2; payload bytes are not an ordinary continuation.

units.name: SoundTick
units.summary: Skip work when sound control bit0 is set. Otherwise advance stream timing, visit four channels, then accumulate the signed fade control. Preserve the channel-enable mask across its shifting iteration.

units.name: SoundSilenceChannel
units.summary: Map reversed low two channel-index bits to APU register groups; write the silent volume value, with triangle using zero.

units.name: SoundWriteRegister
units.summary: Translate channel X and register offset Y to an APU address; preserve A while calculating the register index.

units.name: SoundRequest
units.summary: Temporarily set sound control bit0 while decoding a request, then restore it.

units.name: SoundSelectSequence
units.summary: Commands F0 and above use an inline dispatch. Other requests wrap against the sequence count, read a pointer and compare its priority before replacing stream state. A zero first byte selects the initialization path. Exact tune identities remain unresolved.

units.name: SoundInitializePointers
units.summary: Finish clearing channel arrays, then read four effect-stream pointers as high/low byte pairs. These share the stream reader scratch; no extra header is skipped.

units.name: SoundInitialize
units.summary: Reset tempo/fade and channel work arrays for a zero initialization header, then load four effect pointers from high/low byte pairs. Continue through the shared channel-enable initialization.

units.name: SoundControlDispatch
units.summary: Preserve Y and dispatch the low three command bits through an inline target list.

units.name: SoundStopSequence
units.summary: Clear stream, priority and auxiliary state; invert selected channel bits before silencing the disabled channels.

units.name: SoundClearEffectPointers
units.summary: Clear both halves of all four effect pointers; the enable-mask path subsequently marks only active effect channels dirty.

units.name: SoundApplyEnableMask
units.summary: Visit four reversed APU channels and silence those absent from the mask; then initialize sweep and enable all four tone/noise channels.

units.name: SoundPauseResume
units.summary: Set or clear sound-control bit1. The pause path also clears active duration; the mask command normalizes a shifted channel mask and preserves the all-channel sentinel.

units.name: SoundSetPitchScale
units.summary: Negate the command parameter into the global pitch-scale byte.

units.name: SoundReadSequenceEvent
units.summary: Decrement active duration, or consume an event mask from the sequence stream. Optional fields update stream looping, transpose and note timing; multiplication derives a gate duration. Channel-mask changes refresh silencing before the new mask is committed.

units.name: SoundUpdateChannel
units.summary: Resolve the channel instrument, update its envelope, and stop notes when duration expires. In command mode consume a bitmask of per-channel changes and then a note/rest byte.

units.name: SoundChannelCommandDispatch
units.summary: Dispatch a channel command through five little-endian inline field-setter targets. Supported field masks select these five entries; arbitrary higher mask bits have no established contract.

units.name: SoundDecodeNote
units.summary: A zero note clears envelope timing. Other notes mark pitch dirty, choose a portamento parameter and either calculate a tone period or select a noise value. Music and effects share these channel arrays.

units.name: SoundReadStreamByte
units.summary: Read through D0:D1 and advance the 16-bit sequence pointer, carrying into its high byte.

units.name: SoundUpdateEffectStream
units.summary: Select the effect half of the channel arrays, subtract tempo from note/gate timers and parse more commands when they expire. Packed notes combine a duration class with a five-bit note; zero is a rest.

units.name: SoundEffectCommandDispatch
units.summary: Commands below four have no extra byte; later commands fetch a parameter before inline dispatch through twenty-five handler targets. Commands beyond the supported table remain invalid/uncertain.

units.name: SoundToggleEffectFlags
units.summary: Toggle duration/style bits or set the triplet-like duration flag in the effect channel control byte. The exact authored command names are unknown.

units.name: SoundEffectSetLoopTarget
units.summary: Clear loop state and read a two-byte effect address into the saved loop target. Other nearby handlers replace duration, style and transpose parameters.

units.name: SoundEffectCountedBranch
units.summary: Four entry points select one of four per-channel counters. An exhausted counter either reloads the command count or falls through; a taken loop reads a target pointer, while the untaken path skips its two bytes. The command class distinguishes finite repeats from the alternate terminating form.

units.name: SoundEffectMergeFlags
units.summary: Replace selected effect control bits with the command parameter. The terminating entry discards the dispatch return, clears this stream pointer and returns through the channel-silencing path.

units.name: SoundReadEffectByte
units.summary: Form a pointer from the split per-channel stream arrays and increment that pointer after reading one byte.

units.name: SoundReleaseEnvelope
units.summary: Replace low envelope-state bits with release state3, preserving the channel flags.

units.name: SoundRestartEnvelope
units.summary: Clear the envelope state; triangle channels get special timing from the current duration and channel volume multiplier. Preserve the note index in Y.

units.name: SoundNoteToPeriod
units.summary: Clamp the note index below 60h, track pitch changes and load a 16-bit period from the note table. Special cases preserve or reset portamento/envelope state.

units.name: SoundResetModulation
units.summary: Clear modulation phase only when the instrument or channel flags request it; retain the other channel control bits.

units.name: SoundSetVolume
units.summary: Merge the parameter with duty/volume control except for the triangle-specific path.

units.name: SoundSetInstrument
units.summary: Store the instrument number, mark its parameters dirty, and compute its eight-byte record pointer from the shared bank-local instrument base.

units.name: SoundSetFinePitch
units.summary: Store the signed fine-pitch adjustment for the indexed channel.

units.name: SoundSetDuty
units.summary: Keep the low volume nibble and combine duty/control bits with constant volume mode.

units.name: SoundEnvelopeDispatch
units.summary: Dispatch the low three envelope-state bits while retaining the current amplitude in scratch C4.

units.name: SoundEnvelopeAttack
units.summary: Add a table-selected rate until amplitude saturates at F0h, then advance envelope state.

units.name: SoundEnvelopeDecay
units.summary: Subtract the instrument decay rate, clamping at its sustain threshold and advancing state when reached.

units.name: SoundEnvelopeRelease
units.summary: Subtract the release rate until zero; triangle follows a separate direct zero path. Every finished stage advances the low state bits.

units.name: SoundRenderEnvelope
units.summary: Combine envelope amplitude, fade, duty and channel volume; write the APU volume/control register. Effects and music select different fade handling.

units.name: SoundRenderPitch
units.summary: Apply instrument modulation to the base period, optionally add the global pitch scale, convert to APU timer bits and suppress unchanged high-register writes to avoid retriggering length counters.

units.name: SoundAdvancePortamento
units.summary: If pitch-dirty is set, move the base period using a signed step. Clear that flag at completion, then advance the instrument modulation phase with carry toggling direction bits.

units.name: ResetReplicaBank1
units.summary: Replicated reset wrapper: disable interrupts, perform the mapper reset write through an INC at FFD9, and jump to fixed startup C0AF. The instruction writes a CPU alias, not a physical ROM edit.

units.name: ResetReplicaBank3
units.summary: Replicated MMC1 reset wrapper; execution bank identity is physical bank3 despite the same CPU alias FFD8.

units.name: ResetReplicaBank5
units.summary: Replicated MMC1 reset wrapper; the fixed startup target does not establish this bank as fixed outside its saved context.

units.name: ResetReplicaBank7
units.summary: Replicated MMC1 reset wrapper matching the validated reset contract.

units.name: ResetReplicaBank9
units.summary: Replicated MMC1 reset wrapper matching the validated reset contract.

units.name: SceneBankEntryVectors
units.summary: Bank-local service vectors select title, scene entry, pause, diagnostics and display helpers. Destinations are CPU aliases in this physical PRG pair.

units.name: SceneServiceVectors
units.summary: Three entry trampolines for the status panel and animated display services in this switchable PRG pair.

units.name: TitleContinueSelection
units.summary: Upload title panels and offer a saved-game choice only when RAM signature bytes are 35h,53h. Left/right or SELECT toggles the option; START accepts it. A new game enters name setup. Both choices restore lives, clear restart state and normalize saved record flags before entering the scene.

units.name: SceneEntryPalette
units.summary: Choose the scene palette and dispatch scene initialization; indices8 through11 use the alternate entry. The palette exception at scene2 is explicit, while exact palette identities remain unresolved.

units.name: SceneInitialize
units.summary: Set player health to3, blank the screen, select palette and clear scene work. Clear actor RAM, load spawn records/display parameters and return through the bank service. Saved life stock at06D8h is separate from health30h.

units.name: SceneLoadSpawnRecords
units.summary: Clear scene-local state and initialize forty spawn slots as inactive. Follow a scene-indexed split pointer and copy five-byte records into five parallel arrays until marker88h. Record fields are type and two coarse/fine coordinate pairs.

units.name: SceneLoadDisplayParameters
units.summary: Select CHR banks, map type, scrolling origin, player coordinates and scene flags from parallel scene-indexed arrays. Preserve selected coordinates on restart; initialize the timer digits and activate the scene.

units.name: NewGameNameEntry
units.summary: Clear forty saved-state bytes, choose randomized initial values and prepare the name grid. Direction input wraps a four-column, ten-row selector; A appends a tile to an eight-character name and B erases. START or eight characters accepts; an all-blank name receives the default. Store the save signature before entering the introduction.

units.name: IntroductionPanels
units.summary: Set the initial map location and text context, then alternate selected display records with timed waits. The sequence uses a stack-held index while nested bank/display services run.

units.name: FadeWithSevenFrameStep
units.summary: Select fade step7 and tail-call the common fade service; callers supply the remaining display state.

units.name: EndingPresentation
units.summary: Silence the current sequence, upload successive ending panels, wait, then present a text/portrait scene. The interaction loop waits for A or B, fades out and restores the final map/title state. Natural six-key completion is not established by this routine alone.

units.name: WaitForResetChord
units.summary: Render a frame repeatedly until newly pressed buttons equal F0h, then jump to reset. The exact menu use of this isolated classified loop is uncertain.

units.name: EndingPanelSequence
units.summary: Visit five rows of split stream-pointer tables. Each row contains up to eight pointers and ends when the high byte is FFh. Upload one stream per frame, pause between rows, then display three timed text panels.

units.name: PauseUntilStart
units.summary: Pause sound, wait for a serviced frame and silence APU output. Poll newly pressed START, then restore sound and return through the scene-bank service.

units.name: PrepareCoordinateDiagnostic
units.summary: Negate two saved sixteen-bit coordinate pairs into scratch before drawing their hexadecimal values. This is a diagnostic-style display; its natural entry condition remains unknown.

units.name: DrawCoordinateDiagnostic
units.summary: When enabled and OAM space exists, emit five pairs of hexadecimal digits at fixed screen positions. Blink attributes come from the frame counter. Each nibble helper advances OAM X by four and returns zero when X wraps, allowing the caller to stop.

units.name: DrawHighHexNibble
units.summary: Select the upper nibble, add tile F0h and append one sprite tile; OAM X advances by four.

units.name: DrawLowHexNibble
units.summary: Select the lower nibble, add tile F0h and append one sprite tile; OAM X advances by four.

units.name: PaletteAndSoundDiagnostic
units.summary: Save the PPU control shadow, suspend normal display work and show palette RAM as hexadecimal sprite digits. Up/down selects one of sixteen entries; left/right edits its six-bit color, with action buttons selecting coarse steps. Disallowed colors are skipped for nonzero entries. START auditions the selected sound value. The exit chord restores display state and hides the diagnostic sprites.

units.name: AnimationDiagnostic
units.summary: Keep actor slot1 at a fixed position and cycle its seven-bit animation index with left/right presses, resetting frame timing after each change. Controller chords reset the game or open the palette diagnostic. Render the actor once per frame.

units.name: TileRecordDiagnostic
units.summary: Show a two-byte selector as hexadecimal tiles. Horizontal input adjusts the low byte, B toggles the high byte and A renders the selected record through the shared sprite helper. Values are retained on the stack across nested rendering calls; natural callers are unresolved.

units.name: DisplaySequenceInitialize
units.summary: Set the display control shadow, clear sequence position/timing and mark the current sequence disabled before joining the animation update.

units.name: DisplayAnimationReset
units.summary: Reset animation position and subframe counter before falling into the eight-frame animation update.

units.name: DisplayAnimationTick
units.summary: Every eight updates advance the display sequence. FFh disables it; otherwise select a stream, loop at its FFh terminator, set CHR banks and draw the selected sprite/palette records. Bit7 suppresses part of drawing.

units.name: StatusPanelInitialize
units.summary: Run inline PPU upload commands, clear text state and prepare panel records. Inline parameters following D164 are consumed by the helper, not ordinary instructions.

units.name: StatusBuildNameCommand
units.summary: Copy a six-byte PPU command template and patch two tile bytes selected by saved name/index state.

units.name: StatusBuildInventory
units.summary: Build an eight-character panel command from saved RAM, then iterate key-display tiles until the acquired-key count is reached. The loop uses the saved count as its bound.

units.name: StatusFormatResource
units.summary: Convert the resource byte into decimal tens/remainder by repeated subtraction of ten, then translate both digits through the tile lookup table.

units.name: StatusPanelFrameWait
units.summary: Enable NMI, select palette masking and wait for the next serviced frame before constructing the purchase-menu display.

units.name: ResourcePurchaseMenu
units.summary: Build the resource panel and a two-by-two purchase selector. Direction input repeats on a byte timer; A checks the selected price and mode restrictions before granting health, timed effects or a life. Deduct currency only on success, refresh the display and play accept/reject sounds. SELECT exits through palette restoration.

units.name: StatusBuildKeyTiles
units.summary: Fill four key tile positions from split tables, preserve X/Y and invoke an inline PPU command. Payload/return continuation needs its existing bank contract.

units.name: QueueMenuCursor
units.summary: The normal entry draws a blinking cursor; the erase entry pushes the blank tile instead. Derive the PPU address from row/column selection, append a one-tile command and update the queue write index. The pushed tile is consumed within this helper.

units.name: ResetReplicaBank11
units.summary: Replicated MMC1 reset wrapper in physical bank11.

units.name: SpaceSceneInitialize
units.summary: Fill two nametables, upload scene streams and initialize command/progress scratch, queue indices and a small RAM block before enabling display. Exact command meaning remains in the existing space-scene commentary.

units.name: SpaceScriptTick
units.summary: Move two coordinates toward targets by a speed selected from a table. A countdown gates script consumption; negative command bytes change flags, skip bytes or finish the script, while ordinary commands encode speed, direction and duration.

units.name: SpaceScriptReadCommand
units.summary: Read a byte through the script pointer. Values FBh..FFh select control cases; other bytes provide a three-bit rate and four-bit target selector.

units.name: SpaceScriptAdvance
units.summary: Handle script controls by advancing the pointer with carry. Commands can set a spawn flag, perform a relative skip, save a branch distance or update a one-bit actor mode.

units.name: SpaceScriptEnd
units.summary: Select a fade transition on the FFh terminator. The post-call continuation is not classified.

units.name: SpaceScriptSetTarget
units.summary: Decode target coordinates and velocity offsets from parallel tables. Low duration nibble times five supplies the countdown; consume the two-byte command.

units.name: SpaceProjectilesTick
units.summary: Spawn available projectiles on a frame-mask cadence, with a separate reserved actor slot. Initialize OAM and parallel movement fields from current scripted position; exact projectile artwork identities are unknown.

units.name: SpaceMoveProjectiles
units.summary: Iterate four-byte sprite slots from6Ch upward. Select velocity curves from age/direction, scale them by the script rate, integrate fractional coordinates and hide sprites outside the visible bounds.

units.name: SpaceRenderReservedActor
units.summary: Retain the previous rate, move the reserved actor by script displacement, then expand it into multiple OAM sprites using mode-dependent tile tables.

units.name: SpaceRenderPrompt
units.summary: Build a direction/action prompt from encoded command flags and frame phase. Select a twelve-sprite record group from four parallel Y/tile/attribute/X fields and fill OAM backward in four-byte steps. Frame blinking can alternate prompt selections.

units.name: SpacePromptFeedback
units.summary: A feedback countdown controls prompt replacement and movement; mode selects one of two sprite paths, and expiration hides the prompt.

units.name: SpaceCheckPromptInput
units.summary: Decode a bounded newly pressed input, compare it with the expected prompt and optionally the actor mode. Success starts feedback and a sound; failure may skip script bytes or request a different sound. Clear the input latch after the decision.

units.name: SpaceFrameFinish
units.summary: Select a PPU stream from script progress, run any countdown, cycle a three-step palette animation, service the frame and START bank service, then repeat the scripted tick.

units.name: SpacePromptModeZero
units.summary: Copy eight alternate prompt sprites from parallel coordinate/tile/attribute fields. The animation entry moves them upward eight pixels and adds per-sprite horizontal deltas, changing tiles for progress ranges15..17 before rejoining the scene renderer.

units.name: ActorProximityAnimation
units.summary: After common actor upkeep, wait for a phase countdown or player distance below48 pixels. Advance animation, set an eight-frame delay and enable extent2. The actor identity is unknown.

units.name: ActorTimedExtentToggle
units.summary: Handle the hit flag by clearing active extent and joining common contact motion. Otherwise alternate animation/extent states on signed 120-frame phase counters. The two companion entries advance the reverse half of that cycle.

units.name: ActorDelayedAnimation
units.summary: Reset phase/extent on contact. Otherwise count upward and advance animation at60 or65 ticks according to the entry; the latter resets phase for the next stage.

units.name: ActorAlignThenExitLeft
units.summary: Approach the player's vertical coordinate one pixel per call. Once aligned, latch phase1 and move left two pixels each call; deactivate on horizontal underflow. Contact uses the shared reaction path.

units.name: ActorVerticalOscillation
units.summary: On contact reset extent and animation state before common reaction. Otherwise move vertically by a quarter pixel per call, reversing direction every64 updates. Phase selects add versus subtract; fractional Y carries into the pixel coordinate.

units.name: ActorInitialFacingMotion
units.summary: Latch the initial horizontal side relative to the player, setting facing flags once. Advance a bounded low-bit motion index while retaining its direction bit, then join the existing contact/movement paths.

units.name: ActorOscillate
units.summary: Reflect an age/index counter at0 and1Fh, move horizontal position one step and apply a table-selected vertical delta with direction flags. Position overflow deactivates the actor.

units.name: ActorModeDispatch
units.summary: On world page1 latch facing and initialize the oscillation path once, then join its movement. Elsewhere, a hit clears phase/extent before common contact motion; ordinary actors enter the timed direction handler.

units.name: ActorTimedDelay
units.summary: Initialize phase50 when zero, then join the direction-selection/movement path. A nonzero phase skips initialization. The phase is reused by the following four-way behavior rather than a standalone sleep timer.

units.name: ActorChooseFourWayMotion
units.summary: Build one horizontal and one vertical direction bit from the player's position. Dispatch the resulting mask to four one-pixel helpers; horizontal overflow deactivates the actor and updates its spawn record. Each helper preserves the remaining direction bits on the stack.

units.name: ActorAlternatingAxisChase
units.summary: Choose horizontal direction once, move for32 calls, then approach the player's vertical coordinate within four pixels. Toggle between these phases; horizontal overflow retires the actor. Contact clears phase/extent before common reaction.

units.name: ActorWalkAndSpawnProjectile
units.summary: Advance a byte phase counter. Between64 and127 ticks control visibility, and at96 create type2Ch in the first free actor slot4..15, copying position and facing with an eleven-pixel vertical offset. Other phases probe map collision, reverse horizontal direction on unsuitable tiles and move one pixel. Edge overflow retires the actor.

units.name: ActorFastHorizontalExit
units.summary: Move two pixels left or three right according to facing and deactivate on coordinate wrap. Common actor upkeep precedes movement.

units.name: ActorDropWaitRise
units.summary: Start when the player is within128 pixels horizontally. Drop four pixels per update until the map probe reports80h, play an impact sound, wait120 calls and rise by half a pixel until Y reaches2Bh. Restore the visibility flag and idle state; phase4 is a terminal held state.

units.name: ActorIndexedVerticalMotion
units.summary: Advance a phase to1Fh and add a signed table delta to the actor vertical coordinate.

units.name: ActorSupportPlayer
units.summary: Compare the actor with the player using a14-pixel vertical and24-pixel horizontal window. On a new supporting actor, reset player motion scratch and remember its slot; align player Y26 pixels above it. Losing this support restores the player falling state and clears the support slot.

units.name: SceneCopyCompanion
units.summary: For selected map pages and coordinate pairs, copy actor0 into slot2 and offset its position. Otherwise deactivate slot2; the copied artwork may represent a scene-specific companion.

units.name: ActorRouteAndContact
units.summary: Use a phase-indexed route table on page3, move vertically and dispatch animation phases. Then compare actor/player positions using absolute differences to establish contact or attachment.

units.name: ActorContactMotion
units.summary: Advance the actor motion phase to20h and apply its table displacement before testing player proximity.

units.name: ActorAttachmentCheck
units.summary: Reject contact outside narrow horizontal/vertical bounds. Landing clears vertical motion; side attachment stores the actor index and locks movement until the separation/input conditions release it.

units.name: ActorAttachmentSpecial
units.summary: Run the shared attachment/scene-rise helper before entering the transition actor setup. Stack/register behavior belongs to that helper and the continuation, not an independent actor name.

units.name: SceneExitTransition
units.summary: Create a transition actor in slot14 and choose scene-dependent text. One branch performs several timed uploads, removes that actor and sets a completion flag. Reset the stack to30h and jump into the common scene loop, deliberately abandoning this call chain.

units.name: ActorAttachmentAlternate
units.summary: Page3 reuses attachment positioning; other pages call the same scene animation helper.

units.name: SceneAlternateExitTransition
units.summary: Create type30h in slot14, show the scene-specific message and run the shared ascent before entering the common scene loop.

units.name: ActorAttachmentPalette
units.summary: Set the player animation and preserve the actor index while invoking palette animation.

units.name: MoveSceneUpFortyEightSteps
units.summary: Repeat48 times with a stack-held count: move actor14, player render Y and player actor Y up one pixel, render the scene and wait a frame. Nested calls must preserve this live counter.

units.name: CollectNearbyResource
units.summary: Check a14-by10-pixel proximity window, deactivate the collected actor and mark its spawn record consumed. Add five to the saved resource byte, saturating at99, then play the pickup sound.

units.name: ProjectileActorCollision
units.summary: Move the projectile horizontally by four using its facing flag. Scan active actor slots3..14 and use type-specific hit thresholds plus extent tables to test rectangular overlap. Increment hit count when a type needs repeated hits; otherwise mark the target hit with directional flags and reset animation timing. Any successful hit retires the projectile.

units.name: ActorTerrainWalker
units.summary: A hit selects the defeat animation and a bounded sixteen-step vertical table. Otherwise periodically face the player, move one pixel, and probe map tiles around the actor. Solid and slope properties choose vertical correction or gravity. Slope40h/50h align Y to world X modulo16; map-row alignment preserves the saved page nibble.

units.name: ActorMapRowBase
units.summary: Reconstruct the map-row Y byte from the sampled tile page and vertical origin, applying a page borrow when needed, then subtract16. Callers add the slope's sub-tile height.

units.name: ActorActivateNearPlayer
units.summary: On hit use the shared defeat path. Otherwise wait until the player is within16 pixels vertically, select facing from horizontal order and advance the animation/state index.

units.name: ActorTerrainCharge
units.summary: Use the shared defeat path on hit. Otherwise select facing while outside the32-pixel vertical band; inside it, probe front/support tiles and advance horizontally by1+50h/256 pixels. Stop or reselect state at incompatible map properties and retire on horizontal overflow.

units.name: ActorTimedStateChoice
units.summary: Clear the active extent and count to60 updates before combining random-state bytes for the next actor state. Exact authored actor identity remains unresolved.

units.name: ActorDropAndRecoverAnimation
units.summary: Drop four pixels each call until Y reachesB8h, reset animation timing and advance state with a sound. The next state enables extent6 at frame2 and returns to idle animation11h at frame3.

units.name: ActorLaunchWhenNear
units.summary: Wait for the player within64 pixels horizontally, set upward speed7 and enter animation4Ch. The rising state subtracts fractional acceleration1Eh, reducing speed on borrow; at the apex switch to descent. The falling state increases speed with the same fractional accumulator and retires belowF0h.

units.name: ActorPatrolMapSurface
units.summary: Choose initial facing from player position. Probe the appropriate map side and move one pixel while properties80h/A0h permit, for at most64 updates per leg. Reverse at the limit or an unsuitable surface, and retire on coordinate overflow.

units.name: ActorDelayedTargetAnimation
units.summary: Initialize a twenty-call delay, then select animation2Ah and save player X. Set facing when the player is on the right. The next animation state waits for frame3, advances state, clears timing and starts a128-call movement phase.

units.name: ActorTimedTerrainTravel
units.summary: Count down the128-call phase, advance animation and clear timing at its end. During travel, right-facing motion probes a slope and may climb one pixel; left-facing motion waits for property80h before moving. Horizontal wrap retires the actor.

units.name: ActorPrepareSixWayBurst
units.summary: On first entry initialize child actor slots10..15 as type1Ah, retaining the parent slot on the stack. At phase100 activate all six at the parent's position with distinct route selectors10..15; at120 reset phase and retreat one animation state.

units.name: ActorSixWayBurstMotion
units.summary: Child selectors10..15 choose one of three signed vertical-delta tables and left/right movement of two pixels. Each table has an explicit bound52,34 or16; after it, descend two pixels until offscreen. Retiring a child clears its route/phase/Y and restores the saved horizontal origin.

units.name: ActorCreateLinkedCompanion
units.summary: A hit notifies the companion slot and enters the shared defeat path. Otherwise allocate one type16h companion, save reciprocal slot links and place it20 pixels above the parent. Wait for vertical proximity, latch facing and a32-call delay, then trigger the linked attack after the delay expires.

units.name: ActorLinkedAttackTravel
units.summary: During the short attack phase keep companion X aligned with the parent and move the parent one pixel according to facing. On timeout restore the preceding animation and timing. Overflow retires the parent through spawn-record handling.

units.name: ActorLinkedAttackRecovery
units.summary: Notify the linked actor on hit. Otherwise count down the recovery phase and restore animation20h with cleared phase/direction/link work when finished.

units.name: ActorLinkedProjectileTravel
units.summary: Before launch, remain alive only while the parent is active. Once launched, probe collision properties80h/40h/50h, move two pixels horizontally from the direction bit and retire on impact or coordinate overflow.

units.name: ActorExclusiveSpawnCycle
units.summary: When the scene-wide exclusion byte is clear, count to128 and allocate a type14h linked actor above the parent. Save reciprocal slot links and claim the exclusion byte. At phase144 release the child's hold flag; at192 reset the cycle and exclusion state.

units.name: ActorLinkedFallThenFace
units.summary: A held actor checks its parent's active flag and disappears with it. Once released, fall two pixels until the map probe reports a support property, then set a24-call phase, advance animation and face toward the player.

units.name: ActorMovingSupportContact
units.summary: Compare player and actor coordinates within narrow vertical and horizontal tolerances. Contact saves the support index, clears both velocity pairs and snaps the player above it; separation clears support and sets falling state.

units.name: ActorArcAndAreaContact
units.summary: For ordinary states, apply a signed vertical delta selected by the countdown, retiring on vertical wrap. State23h instead scans slots4..15 for actors within16 pixels on each axis, marks directional hits and clears target animation timing. Then move two pixels horizontally, probe terrain and apply downward motion when unsupported.

units.name: ActorStopOnTerrain
units.summary: Allow properties00h/30h/90h. Any other property selects animation29h, clears animation timing and discards the caller's return before returning to its caller. This early exit is valid only for the adjacent movement call chain.

units.name: ActorReserveSlotOne
units.summary: Move the indexed object into reserved slot1 if available, then test a17h by10h contact rectangle around it. Clamp the player coordinate around the support and clear movement while attached; release clears the attachment flag.

units.name: CollectCurrencyActor
units.summary: Within12 pixels on both axes, deactivate the actor, mark its spawn record consumed and increment currency up to99. Play the collection sound. Repeated writes to the spawn flag preserve the original behavior.

units.name: CollectQuestBitActor
units.summary: Within12 pixels on both axes, remove the actor, consume its spawn record and merge its phase bits into saved quest byte06EDh. The companion entry uses an eight-pixel horizontal window and sets bit7 instead. Exact item identities are unresolved.

units.name: TestQuestLocationGate
units.summary: Require quest byteBFh, player flagsC0h and exact world/page/player Y values, with horizontal world fine X in9Ch..9Dh. Clear two motion bytes and increment the scene gate state. These are exact predicates; the named quest/NPC identity is not established.

units.name: DemoDispatch
units.summary: Dispatch the recorded-demo state through the fixed inline target helper. The following inline table is not established code.

units.name: PrepareQuestTransitionActors
units.summary: Clear ordinary actor slots4..15. Preserve any type1Dh representation in slot2 with copied saved coordinates, then initialize slot1 as type20h at a fixed position. This changes the transition scene population, not global spawn classification.

units.name: ResetQuestPresentation
units.summary: Select player animationAFh, clear frame and saved quest/resource bytes, set the text mode and tail-call message62h. The adjacent helper changes slot2 animation and clears timing for slots4..7.

units.name: SpawnFourVerticalEffects
units.summary: Four entry points select slots4..7 and Y positions94h/6Ch/44h/1Ch. Activate type33h with X near94h using world parity. The first entry also changes slot2's animation.

units.name: ActorArcAndScreenHit
units.summary: Apply a twenty-step signed vertical arc and two-pixel leftward motion. Other actor slots hold the final arc index and probe terrain; slot2 triggers an area hit after the arc, marking eligible actors within48 pixels vertically. Blink scroll twice with a stack-held count, then retire slot2.

units.name: ActorPeriodicShot
units.summary: Advance phase; change animation at10 and70 ticks and attempt a shot at120. Search free slots4..14, create type66h at an18-pixel lower and24-pixel left offset, and play the launch sound. A hit enters the shared defeat animation.

units.name: DrivingSceneInitialize
units.summary: Initialize player/vehicle/effect actor types and a run of seven scene objects, then rebuild the map/display and start the scene sound. Existing driving-loop commentary explains the frame-level control and scrolling state.

units.name: DrivingPlayerTick
units.summary: Delay until the startup counter reachesE1h, then cache player coordinates. Dispatch collision/finish states and process up/down speed selection plus held A/B acceleration and braking.

units.name: DrivingAccelerate
units.summary: Held buttons move a fractional/integer speed pair toward the selected gear with different acceleration and braking steps; zero speed invokes stop handling.

units.name: DrivingSoundAndSteering
units.summary: Convert speed into a sound parameter, ensure driving sound is active, and dispatch steering by actor state and held left/right controls.

units.name: DrivingSteerRight
units.summary: Accelerate the signed horizontal velocity up to its positive bound, check edge/animation restrictions and add it to player position. Collision probes precede the common move finish.

units.name: DrivingSteerFixedRight
units.summary: Move one pixel and probe the scene at the fixed right-steering selector.

units.name: DrivingSteerLeft
units.summary: Mirror the positive steering path with a negative signed velocity and left boundary; a separate fixed steering state probes the alternate selector.

units.name: DrivingProbeObstacles
units.summary: Probe two scene positions and enter collision state3 if either reports80h; otherwise continue motion integration.

units.name: DrivingCollisionScroll
units.summary: Advance vertical world scroll by one with F0h page wrap, update map-cell position and streaming, then count22 reaction updates. At completion clear reaction/motion state, restore active flags and set the next speed/state bytes before the common object loop.

units.name: DrivingAdvanceWorld
units.summary: Subtract speed from fractional world progress, normalize the vertical page atF0h, trigger page-specific CHR/palette changes and schedule map streaming. Set completion when the world origin reaches its terminal bound.

units.name: DrivingActorDispatch
units.summary: Scroll active actors, spawn from the stream and visit slots4..15. Actor type chooses dedicated obstacle/pickup paths; disabled slots are skipped.

units.name: DrivingObstacleContact
units.summary: Use rectangular overlap to detect this obstacle. On contact set reaction timer29h, change the player animation, clear timing and scroll delta, retire the obstacle and play sound3Fh before joining frame finish.

units.name: DrivingMoveObstacle
units.summary: Move this obstacle upward five pixels and return to the actor scan.

units.name: DrivingObstacleFlags
units.summary: Toggle the actor movement flag at a position/phase boundary and clear a scene flag when the special phase ends.

units.name: DrivingLimitObjects
units.summary: Mark a newly active actor once, limiting the counted class to two simultaneous entries. Timers and negative states select delayed or alternate behaviors.

units.name: DrivingActorSlopeAndContact
units.summary: Signed phase sentinels select transition motion. Otherwise use tile probes, scene scroll speed and timed phase choices to move vertically, with random short dwell intervals. Horizontal tile properties40h/50h select side motion; cached direction persists until blocked, then countdown exhaustion changes phase. Screen underflow retires the actor and decrements the active count. Exact object identities remain unresolved.

units.name: DrivingProbeActor
units.summary: Probe two map points for side/slope properties40h/50h, selecting signed transition states when hit. Otherwise, while player reaction gates are clear, rectangular player contact sets a lateral reaction and actor displacement. Continue into phase-dependent vertical motion, timed/random dwell and horizontal terrain response.

units.name: DrivingActorCountdown
units.summary: Count down the actor timer; at zero deactivate it and decrement the scene active count. Both paths rejoin the common actor scan.

units.name: DrivingDirectionalContact
units.summary: Test directional contact only while moving, then return to the actor iteration.

units.name: DrivingPickupAndImpact
units.summary: The collision branch sets scene reaction flags, player/actor animations and sound. The currency branch adds one up to99 and removes the pickup. Transitional actor motion moves horizontally two pixels or upward three according to signed phase state, then rejoins the shared scene actor loop.

units.name: DrivingSecondContact
units.summary: Use rectangular contact to collect the actor. On overlap add one currency up to99, deactivate it and play the pickup sound before continuing the actor scan.

units.name: DrivingActorAnimationDelay
units.summary: Negative states select finite animation delays; counts stop at0Ah or10h before rejoining the scan. The recovered directional handlers share the actor scan continuation.

units.name: DrivingPlayerFeedback
units.summary: Attachment state bypasses normal feedback. During timed feedback move an auxiliary sprite around player coordinates using a triangular phase, then restore default animations and movement fields.

units.name: DrivingSpecialTiles
units.summary: Tile10h starts timed feedback and resets related actor fields. Tile80h clears update queues and enters failure; tile30h starts a different delayed transition.

units.name: DrivingFinishAndPalette
units.summary: While running, cycle a page-specific palette with a divided counter. Completion moves the player up three pixels per frame until it disappears, clears PPU command indices, blanks the display, uploads the terminal panel and enters the one-time completion award.

units.name: DrivingFrameFinish
units.summary: Expire transition countdowns, service START, build OAM/HUD and wait for the frame. A newly pressed SELECT at the initialized startup state opens the status menu; repeat the driving tick.

units.name: DrivingDirectionalObstacle
units.summary: Skip inactive actors, then use the directional contact helper. The successful path advances animation/state and chooses signed horizontal motion from random state and current scene speed; the common actor continuation handles later movement.

units.name: DrivingActorRandomMotion
units.summary: After the entry predicate succeeds, advance state and choose a signed horizontal displacement from the random generator and scene speed. A per-frame table advances animation/phase; retire actors outside the horizontal bound. Shared loop continuation and counters retain their prior mechanical roles.

units.name: DrivingTableMotion
units.summary: Add a phase-indexed signed delta to the actor vertical coordinate.

units.name: DrivingStop
units.summary: Mark stopped state, clear motion flags and queue a stop sound, then restore gear1 and centered steering velocity.

units.name: DrivingRectangleContact
units.summary: Use a type-selected pair of extents and absolute coordinate differences. Carry clear reports overlap; carry set reports separation or disabled contact during feedback.

units.name: DrivingForwardContact
units.summary: Like rectangle contact but requires the player on the accepted vertical side before comparing extent. Carry clear is contact.

units.name: DrivingAttachedFeedback
units.summary: During timed attachment, move the auxiliary actor by a triangular phase. At expiry restore default animations, zero animation counters and clear the feedback flag.

units.name: DrivingSpawnStream
units.summary: Resolve the current progress-indexed split pointer. Marker88h ends the stream; matching page/fine coordinates permit allocation in slots4..15. Initialize the actor, restore the saved record cursor, load its X field, clear motion/Y and increment the stream index.

units.name: DrivingSpawnRecordTail
units.summary: Restore the saved record index from the stack, read its next field into actor X, clear actor motion work/Y and advance the spawn-stream index. The leading record parser remains in the carried source.

units.name: TrainSceneInitialize
units.summary: Select graphics/palette/message state, establish the map origin and rebuild its initial display. Existing train frame-loop commentary supplies the surrounding movement contract.

units.name: TrainPlayerTick
units.summary: Copy player position, accelerate automatically to speed4, then use held B to brake down to speed1. Clear per-frame transient state and pass speed to the world advance helper.

units.name: TrainTerrainDecision
units.summary: Save current speed and resolve pending reaction timers before normal input. Probe multiple points around the player, interpreting properties10h/20h/30h/40h/50h as distinct track/contact cases and60h/70h as a terminal hazard path. Held horizontal direction changes which side probes can trigger reactions. Repeated side tests account for facing and animation68h; exact authored track-piece names remain uncertain.

units.name: TrainMoveRightReaction
units.summary: Latch reaction direction and a32-unit timer. Repeat movement for the current speed, writing each displacement into the circular history. When the train is centered, advance the world origin instead and compensate the scene displacement. Select animation69h and record facing in the history flags.

units.name: TrainMoveLeftReaction
units.summary: Mirror the right reaction with coordinate borrow, reverse history displacement and facing. The same speed-bounded loop chooses screen motion or world scrolling at the center position.

units.name: TrainNeutralReaction
units.summary: Select the neutral animation, clear movement/facing in the history record and reset reaction timers. The following path uses delayed history to constrain the player's separation from the train to17 pixels, choosing animation from recorded direction.

units.name: TrainActorsTick
units.summary: Accumulate speed toward map streaming, then iterate active actors4..15 by their behavior state. State0 is inert; other states select motion, contact or pickup paths.

units.name: TrainDeactivate
units.summary: Clear the actor active byte when it crosses the scene boundary.

units.name: TrainActorMotion
units.summary: Test the vertical bound and special type values before advancing per-actor animation counters.

units.name: TrainContact
units.summary: Compare absolute coordinate differences against23/15-pixel extents for player and auxiliary actor slots; overlap sets actor flags21h. The response sets a120-frame recovery timer, sound and the common damage/life-loss service.

units.name: TrainActorDelay
units.summary: Advance a bounded delay to0Ah and clear the actor low control bit when done.

units.name: TrainResourcePickup
units.summary: Test a18h square around the player; overlap adds five resources capped at99 and deactivates the actor.

units.name: TrainTerminalContact
units.summary: Test a18h by1Fh player contact rectangle, clear PPU command state and invoke the terminal transition on overlap.

units.name: TrainFeedbackAndHud
units.summary: Expire feedback, blink an animation while active and cycle palettes on selected map pages. Service frame work, decrement three decimal timer digits and render their tile values in OAM.

units.name: TrainRenderDigits
units.summary: Render two scene counters and three decimal timer digits with fixed OAM coordinates/attributes. Leading zero digits are selectively hidden by branching around their writes.

units.name: TrainProbePreviousPage
units.summary: Temporarily subtract one vertical world page for a map probe and restore it before returning. The selector in Y is passed unchanged to the common player/map probe.

units.name: TrainAdvanceWorld
units.summary: Add speed to fractional progress and vertical origin, normalize atF0h and trigger palette/CHR changes at selected pages. Convert pixel position to tile coordinates for map streaming.

units.name: TrainHistoryWriteIndex
units.summary: Return the current history write index and advance it modulo64. The read entry advances its independent index by two modulo64; the speed/direction history is a RAM ring, not a ROM pointer list.

units.name: TriviaChooseUnusedQuestion
units.summary: Generate an index below53 from the random byte, reject indices whose used bit is set and mark the accepted question. Store used bits across seven bytes; after32 questions clear the usage set. Double the accepted index to select its text record, retaining the selector on the stack for later comparison.

units.name: TriviaEvaluateAnswer
units.summary: Compare the selected answer with the question's correct-choice byte. Wrong answers show alternate text without advancing quest progress; correct answers advance the text selector and may award the key at3Ah. Update saved NPC progression, remove the talking actor and, at the final NPC stage, remove the remaining type93h actor. The bounded scan uses actor slots4..15.

units.name: TriviaFeedbackPause
units.summary: Queue the answer sound, wait30 serviced frames and reinitialize two text boxes, then return the next text selector in X. These waits use the scheduler, not busy CPU delays.

units.name: TriviaActorDeparture
units.summary: Find the active type93h actor, change its animation/flags and move it right two pixels for50 serviced-frame steps. Hide the actor afterward. The absence case returns without changing another slot.

units.name: TextEmitSavedSelection
units.summary: Derive a glyph selector from saved initial-choice state and emit three glyphs through the text buffer writer, with two glyphs selected from a paired table. The displayed phrase identity remains unresolved.

units.name: ResetReplicaBank13
units.summary: Replicated MMC1 reset wrapper in physical bank13.

units.name: NmiService
units.summary: Preserve flags and registers. Unless display construction is locked, disable rendering, DMA the OAM page, drain PPU queues and upload palette changes. Restore scroll/mask, apply pending CHR bank changes, advance frame/scheduler state and service audio before restoring registers and RTI.

units.name: HardwareAndSchedulerStartup
units.summary: Invalidate the save signature, disable rendering/NMI and initialize the CPU stack. Wait across four complete vblank edges, silence the APU, configure MMC1/CHR selection and clear working RAM. Initialize task records and task0's entry pointer, set the PPU control shadow and join scheduler dispatch. Subsequent soft restart can enter after signature invalidation.

units.name: SchedulerScan
units.summary: Reset the stack and scan four four-byte task records. Select ready tasks only outside the NMI gate; new tasks jump through saved entry pointers, suspended tasks restore their saved stack/registers. Task0 also reads controllers and advances random state.

units.name: SchedulerCreateTask
units.summary: Convert task number to a four-byte record offset, store the entry pointer from34:35 and mark the task new/ready. The clear entry disables one task. The terminating entry disables the running task and abandons its current stack through scheduler restart.

units.name: SchedulerSleep
units.summary: Save X/Y, set this task waiting for A frames, save its stack pointer and return to the dispatcher. NMI decrements the delay and marks the task ready.

units.name: SchedulerTaskOffset
units.summary: Convert the current task number to its four-byte record offset in X.

units.name: WaitForFrame
units.summary: If NMI is enabled and unlocked, request display work and sleep one frame. Otherwise preserve X/Y, directly service the PPU queue and restore both registers before returning.

units.name: WaitFrameCount
units.summary: Wait X serviced frames by decrementing X after each frame wait. X zero therefore requests256 iterations. Nearby wrappers preserve X/Y around actor rendering or hold a separate count on the stack across scene-frame service.

units.name: ServiceSceneFrame
units.summary: Unless the text flag requests otherwise, rebuild actor OAM, then enter the common frame wait.

units.name: DisableNmi
units.summary: Clear the NMI-enable bit in the PPU control shadow and hardware.

units.name: EnableNmi
units.summary: Set the NMI-enable bit in the PPU control shadow and hardware.

units.name: InlineDispatch
units.summary: A selects a little-endian word following the caller return address. Pop that address and tail-jump through EE:EF; target list and normal return layout must be handled by each caller contract.

units.name: DisableRendering
units.summary: Clear sprite/background rendering bits in the PPU mask shadow and hardware.

units.name: MultiplySixteenBySixteen
units.summary: Preserve Y and perform sixteen shift/add steps using a four-byte product work area. EntryC26E clears one multiplier byte for the narrower form; operands and returned product bytes share10..15, so callers must not expect them preserved. Exact fixed-point scaling is determined by which result bytes the caller consumes.

units.name: DivideSixteenByByte
units.summary: Run sixteen restoring-division steps: shift the dividend/quotient pair through a remainder byte, subtract the divisor when possible and set the quotient bit. Preserve Y. The divisor must be nonzero for ordinary arithmetic meaning.

units.name: UploadPpuStream
units.summary: Read address-high, address-low and packed length/mode records through37:38. Flags select increment32 and repeated-byte versus literal payload. A negative next header terminates and clears the pointer-high pending flag.

units.name: ReadInlinePointer
units.summary: Read two bytes following the caller return address into00:01, then advance the stacked return address by two so RTS skips that inline argument. Stack offsets assume the helper is called through another JSR.

units.name: ReadControllers
units.summary: Select recorded input while demo state is active; otherwise strobe4016 and serially read eight bits. Merge the two input lines; F7 retains held buttons and F5 becomes only newly pressed bits.

units.name: FillNametable
units.summary: A supplies the nametable high byte, X the tile fill and Y the attribute fill. Write four pages of tile bytes, then overwrite the64-byte attribute section. Assumes rendering disabled and valid PPU access timing supplied by caller.

units.name: FillRamPages
units.summary: A is fill value; X/Y describe page bounds. Work backward through full256-byte pages using pointer10:11. The carry-clear subtraction makes the upper page exclusive; preserve the exact caller bounds.

units.name: DrawSpriteRecordsInline
units.summary: Consume an inline pointer before entering the shared sprite record renderer.

units.name: DrawSpriteRecords
units.summary: Read visible count, Y, attributes, X and tile stream through00:01. Emit four-byte OAM entries, advance X by8 per tile and treat FFh tile bytes as horizontal skips without decrementing the visible count. FFh in the next-row-count position ends the structure. Records must terminate before eight-bit Y wraps.

units.name: ClearDisplay
units.summary: Disable NMI/rendering, fill a nametable with tile24h and zero attributes, clear scroll, then hide all OAM sprites.

units.name: HideAllSprites
units.summary: Start from OAM offset0; the alternate entry starts at the next free OAM offset. Write F8h to sprite Y every four bytes until page wrap.

units.name: ConfigureMmc1Control
units.summary: Serialize control value1Eh to9FFEh, low bit first across five stores. This sets the mapper's program/character banking mode; register values are not physical bank indices.

units.name: RestorePrgBank
units.summary: Load remembered logical selection43h and enter the switch path. This restores a remembered selection, not necessarily the physical bank that was active on entry; supplied execution views retain the distinction.

units.name: SelectPrgBank
units.summary: Set current logical selection44h and restore scratchEDh, lock mapper/audio work and serialize the MMC1 PRG value. Replay deferred audio if needed, then clear lock. EntryC497 additionally writes remembered43h; raw serial writes do not update43h/44h.

units.name: EnterSceneBankFive
units.summary: Select logical PRG value5 through the critical-section bank service.

units.name: EnterSceneBankSix
units.summary: Select logical PRG value6 through the critical-section bank service.

units.name: AudioFrame
units.summary: Temporarily switch to sound bank0, consume queued sound requests if present, tick the sound engine and restore the active scene bank.

units.name: WriteMmc1Prg
units.summary: Write five low-first serial bits to the MMC1 PRG register atFFF9. A is shifted and destroyed; mapping changes require a fresh effective bank context.

units.name: WriteMmc1ChrUpper
units.summary: Remember the logical CHR value and write five serial bits toDFFF.

units.name: WriteMmc1ChrLower
units.summary: Remember the logical CHR value and write five serial bits toBFD9.

units.name: QueueSoundRemember
units.summary: Remember the request in EA, then enqueue it through the shared ring writer.

units.name: QueueSound
units.summary: Preserve X, place A into an eight-entry ring and wrap the write index modulo8. This prefix does not establish overflow handling.

units.name: FadePaletteTransition
units.summary: Select fade direction and initial brightness, preserving caller X. Copy the32-color base palette, darken unmasked four-color groups with underflow clamped to0Fh and mirror the universal color when required. Wait the requested frame step with a live stack counter while optionally drawing actors. Advance brightness until the endpoint, restore the base palette and clear fade masks before returning.

units.name: FadeSetup
units.summary: Preserve X and select palette fade direction/brightness and frame-step parameters before the shared transition loop. Palette-mask bits choose unaffected four-color groups.

units.name: LoadPaletteCurrent
units.summary: Select the current palette number, then enter the banked palette loader.

units.name: LoadPalette
units.summary: Save the PRG selection, switch to bank0 and fetch a palette stream pointer. First byte is destination index; subsequent nonnegative bytes fill the palette shadow. A mask can black out four-byte groups before marking the upload pending and restoring the bank.

units.name: InitializeActorBanked
units.summary: Preserve the stream selector, select the actor type and switch to logical bank4. Read a count-prefixed field record, clear motion/animation work, copy fields into sixteen-slot RAM planes and restore the bank.

units.name: InitializeActorFields
units.summary: Read a bank-local split initializer pointer and its field count. Clear fractional/motion/animation work for actor X, then copy record bytes into parallel arrays separated by16. Restore the original slot index and bank. Record field count, not a CPU address range, controls the copy.

units.name: ActorApplyGravity
units.summary: Add a quarter pixel to the actor's vertical speed, clamp its fractional component at integer speed2 and integrate the fixed-point pair into Y. Retire through spawn bookkeeping when Y reachesF0h.

units.name: ProbeActorMap
units.summary: Add selector-indexed offsets to the actor position and world origin. Normalize vertical coordinates atF0h and horizontal coordinates with signed carry, convert pixels to16-pixel cells and call the common map lookup. Returned Y describes the tile property.

units.name: TextBoxInitialize
units.summary: Clear line scratch, select a banked text stream and initialize origin/width flags. Convert world-cell position to a PPU address and preserve attribute quadrants where the box only covers part of a cell.

units.name: TextBoxReadLine
units.summary: Read encoded text into the32-byte line buffer, interpreting control bytes FAh and above separately. Empty lines generate a border template; compose alternate rows and schedule PPU commands while tracking row parity and vertical position.

units.name: TextBoxEndLine
units.summary: Generate the final border/blank row using box width/mode flags, flush the composed row and restore the bank before waiting through the common scene frame service.

units.name: TextBoxComposeRow
units.summary: Choose row destinations, fill horizontal borders and spacing, then fetch glyph/control bytes. F8h introduces a pointer substitution; lower values become glyphs while terminal controls advance or stop the stream.

units.name: TextBoxHideCoveredActors
units.summary: Scan sixteen actors for coordinates covered by the box row and set flag10h to suppress their rendering, then advance the row pixel coordinate.

units.name: TextRestoreActorVisibility
units.summary: Clear suppression bit10h in all sixteen actor flag bytes, reset the display exclusion flag and restore the bank. This ends the textbox's temporary covering of actors.

units.name: TextChoiceCursor
units.summary: Erase or blink the menu cursor using counter bit4. Initialize coordinate scratch, derive the selected row/column position and queue the chosen tile through the shared cursor writer. Exact choice labels remain properties of the selected text stream.

units.name: QueueSingleTile
units.summary: Append PPU high/low address, length1, a tile popped from stack and a zero terminator to the RAM queue. The caller deliberately supplies a tile via stack, not a conventional return value.

units.name: TextChoiceInput
units.summary: Reset selector row/column and repeat timer. Held direction advances only when the byte timer wraps; horizontal movement requires a two-column choice layout. Vertical movement wraps within the available choices and rejects the unused final cell of an odd layout. Erase the old cursor before changing selection, then redraw it.

units.name: TextChooseConfirmCancel
units.summary: Select the text bank, update cursor input and service frames until A or B is newly pressed. Preserve the A/B result in carry across cursor erasure and bank restoration: A clears carry, B sets it.

units.name: TextSaveMapBackground
units.summary: Save map state, temporarily select the scrolling direction and build15 strips with a stack-held counter before restoring the previous stream direction. The following save/restore pair copies96 text-buffer bytes to0180h..01DFh plus coordinate scratch. This RAM range overlaps the CPU stack page, so callers must keep live frames outside it.

units.name: TextSaveBufferState
units.summary: Copy96 bytes from0300h into0180h..01DFh, save text row and four coordinate bytes. The inverse entry restores them. This is temporary state storage with a caller stack exclusion requirement, not a separate ROM asset.

units.name: TextSelectStream
units.summary: The inline entry consumes a two-byte text id argument. Resolve its low/high stream pointer through logical bank1, restore the prior bank and render rows until the terminal controls. F9h redirects execution with a bank choice after saving buffer state; ordinary text controls advance rows, wait or finish.

units.name: TextResetRowState
units.summary: Clear row position, line progress and stream index before a fresh text presentation. The indexed entry selects a low-byte text id with high byte zero.

units.name: TextChooseCoordinateOrigin
units.summary: Use camera row/page unless text flag bit7 requests screen-local zero origin. Choose the second coordinate pair from camera column/page, or derive its low coordinate from flag bits2..3. Both sign tests are finite branches; the routine always returns after writing1C..1F.

units.name: TextExpandRow
units.summary: Clear two32-byte buffer planes and construct borders, optionally prepending a numbered choice. Decode bytes from the text stream: F8h enters a banked inline callback using a synthetic CD42 return; dictionary escapes dispatch through the inline table; ordinary glyphs append to the row. Terminal controls are stored for the consumer. The synthetic return lands at TextResumeAfterSyntheticReturn; finite text and protected live stack frames remain required.

units.name: TextExpandPlayerName
units.summary: Recover the text-buffer X saved by the escape dispatcher and append the saved player name for its stored length. Restore the bank afterward; the name length contract is established by the eight-character input editor.

units.name: TextExpandDictionaryWord
units.summary: Read a dictionary id from the stream, switch to logical bank3 and load its split pointer. Append glyphs through FFh, then restore the remembered bank. Stream index advances once for the id; dictionary traversal uses a separate Y.

units.name: TextStoreGlyph
units.summary: Append a glyph at0300h+X and increment X. Callers own row width/capacity and the current text bank.

units.name: TextCursorReset
units.summary: Clear the cursor blink counter and queue the blank cursor tile.

units.name: TextCursorBlink
units.summary: Alternate tile24h/32h from counter bit4 and append it using the single-tile queue helper.

units.name: TextWaitActionsOnly
units.summary: Advance the display and service frames until newly pressed A or B. The adjacent coordinate helper prepares cursor position from the text layout and queues its initial tile.

units.name: TextWaitForButton
units.summary: Repeatedly update animated display and wait for a newly pressed A/B bit, blinking the cursor between frames. Reset the cursor before returning.

units.name: TextWaitContinueCoordinates
units.summary: Restore the current text origin, derive row/column cursor offsets and update its position before entering the existing wait-and-continue path. The return suffix restores the preserved stream pointer/index/choice spacing from the stack and resets row position.

units.name: TextWaitAndContinue
units.summary: Wait for A/B while blinking the cursor. Preserve stream pointer, index and choice spacing on the stack across the next box setup, then restore them and reset row position.

units.name: FlushPpuQueue
units.summary: Read high/low address, packed count and literal bytes from the RAM command queue. High count bit selects vertical increment; zero address terminates. Preserve the read index for incremental flushing.

units.name: QueueAttributePrefix
units.summary: Begin an attribute update in the correct nametable, deriving its high address and low row/column from the attribute index. Horizontal runs split at eight-byte boundaries; vertical runs advance through the attribute shadow by16 modulo128.

units.name: QueueAttributeRun
units.summary: Append attribute bytes from0780h, splitting horizontal runs at an eight-byte nametable attribute boundary. The vertical mode emits one-byte records and advances by16 modulo128. Update the RAM queue write index and terminate with zero; the requested span bounds the copy.

units.name: TextQueueRows
units.summary: Temporarily reduce border width when requested, queue two text row variants and restore width/parity. Plain text mode also queues attributes.

units.name: TextTypewriter
units.summary: Queue top/bottom glyph tiles with nametable wrap handling. Unless instant-text is enabled, add frame delays and accelerate held A/B input. Negative glyph bytes end this path.

units.name: TextCheckStartAbort
units.summary: On negative scene selector and newly pressed START, replace the stack pointer and select scene bank5 to abort the current text context. Ordinary text returns untouched.

units.name: QueueTileRow
units.summary: Split a row at a32-tile nametable boundary, append literal tile data and terminate the command queue. Preserve address low/high and emitted length explicitly; row sources depend on parity and border mode.

units.name: UploadInlinePpuStream
units.summary: Consume a two-byte inline pointer, copy it into the PPU stream pointer and tail-call the stream uploader. Caller RTS resumes after the two argument bytes.

units.name: QueueInlinePpuProgram
units.summary: Consume a two-byte inline pointer, then append its PPU records to the RAM queue. Packed count bit6 expands a repeated byte into literal queued bytes; otherwise copy the payload. FFh ends the program. Preserve count flags other than the expansion bit and append a zero queue terminator.

units.name: UploadHorizontalStrip
units.summary: If a strip is pending, upload24h bytes from0360 and wrap the PPU address between nametables on a32-tile boundary. Clear the pending flag before writing.

units.name: UploadVerticalStrip
units.summary: If pending, enable increment32 and upload1Eh bytes from0360 at the selected column. Clear the flag before access.

units.name: BuildActorOam
units.summary: Select the actor graphics bank, render reserved actors first and alternate ascending/descending order for other actors each frame to distribute sprite priority. Preserve palette bits while drawing, then restore the PRG bank.

units.name: RenderActor
units.summary: Skip actors hidden by flag10h; remove actors beyond the vertical bound. Advance animation frame/delay unless frozen, resolve bank-local animation and composite-sprite pointers and apply flip/palette attributes.

units.name: RenderActorTiles
units.summary: Emit tile/attribute/position tuples through the next free OAM offset. Add signed relative coordinates, hide sprites on horizontal wrap and stop when the sprite count expires or OAM wraps.

units.name: ScrollSpawnRecords
units.summary: First scroll active actors, then update forty dormant spawn records with signed scroll deltas. Vertical cells wrap atF0h; records entering the visible origin may allocate an active actor.

units.name: ScrollActiveActors
units.summary: Apply screen displacement only to active actors with flag20h. Horizontal overflow deactivates them; player/reserved slot0 is excluded by the loop bound.

units.name: ActivateSpawnRecord
units.summary: Find a free actor slot4..15 for a nonnegative record type and invoke its initializer. Return the original spawn record index even if no slot is free.

units.name: ActivateSpawnFieldsAndGates
units.summary: Copy a dormant spawn's fine/coarse position into actor arrays and remember its record index. In selected scene modes suppress already collected quest-bit actors and enforce an active enemy cap. In the trivia mode reject actors whose normalized NPC stage differs from saved progress. Return the original record index even when the actor was immediately retired.

units.name: DeactivateActor
units.summary: Scene/type-specific bookkeeping adjusts counters before clearing active state. Some exits also release special scene flags or restore dormant spawn records.

units.name: ReleaseActorSpawnRecord
units.summary: Clear the actor active bit and release the record's active flag when its record index is nonnegative. Negative indices denote actors without a normal dormant record.

units.name: ShiftSpawnCoordinates
units.summary: Repeat displacement over all forty dormant records using a stack-held outer count. The vertical-page-only form decrements each coarse field; the other forms select signed horizontal/vertical displacement and call the common scrolling updater. Clear temporary displacement bytes when finished.

units.name: ShiftSpawnPages
units.summary: Shift all forty dormant spawn coordinates under a stack-held displacement count. Page-only entry decrements all coarse vertical fields; signed displacement entries call the common scrolling updater and clear temporary deltas afterward.

units.name: HauntedIdleSpawn
units.summary: In scene4, at horizontal coordinate80h while left/right is held, accumulate60 updates and possibly create type26h in reserved slot3. Page and random-bit gates prevent every interval from spawning.

units.name: LookupMapProperty
units.summary: Resolve a map cell, select its property bank, index the packed property record and return its upper six bits in Y. Return with logical PRG bank6 selected; physical bank context must follow the mapper service.

units.name: MapVerticalFromScreen
units.summary: Add A to the current tile-row origin, normalize at15 rows per screen and produce row/page in1C:1D, supporting a negative offset.

units.name: MapVerticalAdvance
units.summary: Add a signed row displacement to1C:1D with15-row page wrapping.

units.name: MapHorizontalFromScreen
units.summary: Start from horizontal world-cell origin and add A, normalizing at16 columns per page.

units.name: MapHorizontalAdvance
units.summary: Add A to the current column/page with16-column normalization; negative offsets borrow one page.

units.name: MapCellToPpuAddress
units.summary: Double column and multiply row by64 to address a2x2 tile cell. Horizontal page parity selects nametable2000 or2400; produce low/high address68:69.

units.name: UpdateScrollDeltas
units.summary: Compute signed pixel displacement from old PPU scroll to the new world origin, limiting vertical wrap to a16-pixel interval. Store new scroll shadows and mirror horizontal page parity into PPUCTRL.

units.name: ResolveMapCell
units.summary: Use row/page and column/page to select map, block and quadrant tables through banked pointers. Extract the cell property index with a packed high-bit plane and resolve its quadrant; bank switches are part of the routine contract.

units.name: MapAttributeIndex
units.summary: Compute the attribute-buffer byte index from half row/column and horizontal page parity; initialize the property page pointer for the current map type.

units.name: ScrollTransitionInitialize
units.summary: Set horizontal displacementF0h and run the staged map transition with an explicit sixteen-step count, clearing displacement before rebuilding map strips.

units.name: ScrollTransition
units.summary: Store displacement and repeat dormant-record scrolling under a stack-held count, decrementing only after the complete forty-record update. Zero count follows eight-bit wrap behavior rather than an immediate exit.

units.name: RebuildMapStrips
units.summary: Advance the row origin, preserve streaming direction and build15 map strips under a stack-held counter. Each iteration resolves cells, queues tiles/attributes and flushes display work. The reverse entry starts one row earlier with the opposite direction. Restore direction and bank afterward.

units.name: ReadAdjacentMapPage
units.summary: Select map bank3, derive a pointer from vertical page and horizontal page and fetch a direction-indexed byte. Restore the previous bank on return.

units.name: StreamMapPhase
units.summary: Initialize a four-phase strip update when idle, decrement its phase and dispatch through an inline target list.

units.name: BuildMapRowCells
units.summary: Choose the initial row/page and populate sixteen metatile cells across four tile planes in0300h or0360h. Extract each cell's low-two-bit palette and merge it into the proper quadrant of0780h without disturbing neighbors. Advance map coordinates between cells and remember the first attribute index for the eventual upload.

units.name: QueueMapStrip
units.summary: Select one of four row buffers and nametable addresses by streaming phase. Queue32 literal bytes, terminate and reset the read pointer; even phases also schedule attributes.

units.name: SceneDispatch
units.summary: Dispatch the scene selector through an inline little-endian target list. Target contracts, not a linear fallthrough, determine subsequent execution.

units.name: SceneGameplayInitialize
units.summary: Initialize the item count and clear the gameplay mode flag, then join common player setup.

units.name: PrepareNpcPaletteTriple
units.summary: Use saved NPC progression to select a three-byte table record and copy it into03FDh..03FFh. Mark palette work pending after exactly three bytes; the bounded suffix of the table has unresolved authored meaning.

units.name: PlayerSetup
units.summary: Activate actor0, derive map-cell coordinates from the world origin and begin the initial scrolling transition.

units.name: GameplayFrame
units.summary: Service START, then choose overhead/hub or platform movement from the scene mode. On the timed interaction path scan nearby actors and initiate a text/fade transition only once per contact.

units.name: PresentNpcInteraction
units.summary: Blank display/background, mark ordinary actors hidden and select the NPC text context. NPC indices below7 select a saved trivia-stage text id; other actors use an inline text id. After confirmation restore map nametables, palette and actor display, with a special departure animation at selector36h.

units.name: OverheadMovement
units.summary: When the scene mode is zero, handle recovery timers and decode held directions on a frame cadence. Map direction to signed fractional speed, moving player coordinates until centered and then scrolling the world instead.

units.name: OverheadVerticalMove
units.summary: Apply direction/speed tables to vertical fractional position. Normalize world pages atF0h and request adjacent map updates when scrolling; derive collision probes from direction.

units.name: OverheadHorizontalMove
units.summary: Apply horizontal velocity with page carry/borrow when the player is centered; otherwise move the player to the center. Probe the map in the selected direction before finalizing.

units.name: OverheadAnimation
units.summary: Select actor flags/animation from direction, damage timer and interaction state. Update player coordinates and camera cell state before the shared frame finish.

units.name: HubEntranceChecks
units.summary: Special horizontal boundaries request CHR changes. Compare six parallel sixteen-entry arrays against quantized world/player coordinates; suppress repeated entry with a latch. Entrance6 additionally requires six keys before the ending transition; other matches set the scene index.

units.name: HubRestoreSpawnPages
units.summary: Derive a spawn-page adjustment from the current vertical page and invoke the shared spawn helper.

units.name: ReturnToHubScene
units.summary: Replace the stack with30h, restore all six world/player coordinates from the current entrance index and select hub scene0Dh. Install a synthetic return to the common scene loop, fade and enter bank5's scene service. This transition deliberately discards the previous call chain.

units.name: PlatformMovement
units.summary: Compute pixel alignment within the current tile row. Handle recovery and attachment states first, then allow ladder-like motion only in a restricted horizontal alignment band; ordinary left/right movement uses signed fixed-point velocity.

units.name: PlatformRecoveryPresentation
units.summary: Blank the display, stop the old sound and select the recovery transition. The continuation retains the existing platform input contract; its inline PPU payload is data.

units.name: PlatformAlignedInput
units.summary: Permit up/down probes while aligned to the tile column; otherwise continue horizontal motion. Special movement state can bypass fresh input handling.

units.name: PlatformLadderMotion
units.summary: On entering the aligned special movement state, snap horizontal position to cell center, clear velocities and refresh camera boundaries. Up/down selects signed fixed-point vertical steps, rate-limits movement sounds and tests map properties before writing Y. Leaving the support surface clears the special state; floor/wall contacts return to ordinary physics.

units.name: PlatformHorizontalAcceleration
units.summary: Damp velocity without directional input; with left/right input accelerate using scene/tile-dependent limits, update facing flags and clamp the signed fixed-point pair.

units.name: PlatformInteractions
units.summary: Select scene-specific inventory/actor interactions, including a type26h proximity scan, and predict the next horizontal coordinate before collision checks.

units.name: PlatformAction
