units.summary: In the alternate scene mode, a newly pressed B bit creates an object only if inventory, slot and recovery conditions permit. Reset its animation and decrement inventory when the current action frame completes.

units.name: PlatformActorCollision
units.summary: Compare predicted player position with selected actor types using absolute coordinate bounds; overlap cancels horizontal velocity and rejoins vertical motion.

units.name: PlatformHorizontalIntegrate
units.summary: Choose positive or negative fixed-point integration. Scroll the world at the center, otherwise update player position and clamp at scene edges. Probe leading tile properties to stop or snap against walls/slopes.

units.name: PlatformPositiveCollision
units.summary: Check several map probes, interpret tile40h/50h as sloped surfaces and snap coordinate alignment when blocked. Queue a camera-column update after a successful move.

units.name: PlatformNegativeIntegrate
units.summary: Negate the signed velocity into a magnitude, subtract fractional position with borrow and handle camera/page transitions. Clamp at the opposite screen edge before probing the left boundary.

units.name: PlatformVerticalJoin
units.summary: Rejoin the common jump/gravity and vertical collision path.

units.name: SpawnPlayerActionObject
units.summary: Initialize reserved actor15, copy player facing/position, offset horizontally by six pixels according to facing and clear animation state. Queue sound3Ch; precise item artwork remains unassigned.

units.name: PlatformSpecialAction
units.summary: A newly pressed B bit at a precise map/player position can initialize type66h in reserved slot2, provided that slot is free. Return to the ordinary interaction path if any gate fails.

units.name: CameraColumnStep
units.summary: Detect crossing of the next16-pixel horizontal boundary, advance its remembered coordinate and schedule four phases with direction2/3.

units.name: CameraColumnReverse
units.summary: Handle the reverse crossing by subtracting16 and selecting direction2; modular distance prevents interpreting the opposite half-cycle as a crossing.

units.name: CameraRowStep
units.summary: Handle forward vertical16-pixel crossing with F0h page wrap and schedule direction1.

units.name: CameraRowReverse
units.summary: Handle reverse vertical crossing, wrapping the low coordinate toE8h and scheduling direction0.

units.name: WorldPixelsToCells
units.summary: Divide fine world coordinates by16, preserve coarse pages and refresh scroll deltas.

units.name: PlayerPixelsToCells
units.summary: Derive map cells for the current player screen position relative to the world origin.

units.name: ProbePlayerMap
units.summary: A scene overflow flag suppresses probing. Otherwise add selector-indexed offsets to player/world coordinates, normalize vertical pages, divide by16 and return the common property lookup in A/Y. Y selects a probe point, not a ROM bank.

units.name: PlatformCheckSupport
units.summary: Probe foot positions and distinguish solid, slope and special tiles. Snap vertical position to the tile alignment and clear vertical velocity on supported surfaces; some paths discard the caller return before joining collision handling.

units.name: PlatformSlopeOne
units.summary: Use horizontal position within a16-pixel cell to derive the support height; snap only inside a narrow vertical band and while not jumping upward. Clear vertical speed and fractional position on landing.

units.name: PlatformSlopeOther
units.summary: Mirror the slope height calculation by using the opposite within-cell horizontal displacement.

units.name: PlatformAdjacentActorCheck
units.summary: Compute player distance from reserved actor1 with17/16-pixel bounds and use the result to adjust nearby support/jump handling. Exact actor identity remains uncertain.

units.name: PlatformJumpGravity
units.summary: Start a jump on newly pressed A if recovery/state gates permit. Releasing A caps upward speed; add40h to fractional vertical speed each tick and clamp falling speed by player height.

units.name: PlatformVerticalIntegrate
units.summary: Integrate vertical fractional/integer velocity into player Y or offscreen overflow storage. Handle bottom/top wrap and refresh map coordinates before probing floor/ceiling collision.

units.name: PlatformCeilingCollision
units.summary: Probe two overhead points; on solid collision clear velocity and snap to tile alignment, entering falling state. Then dispatch scene-specific actor/platform contacts.

units.name: PlatformActorContacts
units.summary: Iterate active actors by type and call their attachment/contact routines. A special map-position plus UP input performs a fixed scene relocation; other states continue camera/player finishing.

units.name: PlatformRelocateScene
units.summary: Disable display, reset motion and choose one of two relocation origins. Select CHR/palette by destination page, call the destination scene initializer through a temporary bank, then rebuild map strips and coordinate latches. Enter the frame loop after a fade unless the current mode requests a direct return.

units.name: PlatformTransitionPoints
units.summary: Scan six source-coordinate/input gates. On a match preserve the route index through fade, load destination coordinate/graphics fields from parallel arrays and rebuild the scene before returning to gameplay.

units.name: PlatformDoorDestination
units.summary: Recover the selected door index from the stack and load its six destination coordinates plus CHR, palette and scene parameters from parallel arrays. Initialize the destination bank, translate dormant spawn records to the new origin and rejoin the common relocation/display rebuild.

units.name: CameraFollowUp
units.summary: Move world origin toward the player by at most two pixels, with vertical page borrow; update the adjacent map page in direction0.

units.name: CameraFollowDown
units.summary: If no overflow and outside the excluded map page, move world origin down at most two pixels and compensate player Y. Schedule the adjacent map page in direction1.

units.name: SelectPlayerAnimation
units.summary: Refresh map position and choose animation from recovery, jump, support, movement and button states. Inventory and attachment select alternate animation ranges before storing actor0 type.

units.name: GameplayMapFinish
units.summary: Probe a property to choose sprite priority, process map streaming and animate palettes when no strip upload remains. Continue into actor updates/frame finish.

units.name: AnimateScenePalette
units.summary: Scene4 cycles palette indices using world-page/frame masks; scene1 uses a six-step slower cycle with page-specific palette and CHR changes. Preserve exact table indices without claiming original effect names.

units.name: MapStreamingTick
units.summary: Prefer whichever row/column streaming operation has progressed below its initial phase4. Select its remembered direction, decrement the phase and dispatch the phase body through an inline table.

units.name: MapStreamResumeCells
units.summary: Restore the saved row/column coordinates and resume at cell11 or5 according to entry. These are staged continuations of the bounded map-strip builder, not new independent map definitions.

units.name: MapStreamBuildCells
units.summary: Use direction and fine world alignment to choose the next row/column. Resolve cells into four tile planes, merge palette quadrants into the attribute buffer and advance coordinates. Save intermediate coordinates at cell5 and11; stop at the direction-specific extent, then record the pending PPU strip address and length. Restore logical bank6 at each staged return.

units.name: MapStreamQueueAttributes
units.summary: Select attribute span10 or8 from orientation, append the attribute commands and restore logical bank6. The caller supplies a valid current cell and queue state.

units.name: MapStreamSelectEdge
units.summary: Add direction-indexed row/column offsets to the world-cell origin and retain the resulting map-cell coordinates as the edge origin. Direction is constrained to0..3 by the streaming scheduler.

units.name: MapStreamPrepareTileUpload
units.summary: Queue edge attributes, recover the orientation-specific PPU address and add the direction offset. Set horizontal or vertical pending tile count from the corresponding direction table. The saved PPU high byte controls one internal branch; it is not an unconditional branch in arbitrary state.

units.name: GameplayActorsAndFrame
units.summary: Run demo control, expire timers, scroll spawn records and perform scene-specific idle spawning. Dispatch each actor by type through split handler tables, then test player contact against type-selected extents.

units.name: GameplayActorContact
units.summary: Compare absolute player/actor coordinate differences to type-indexed vertical/horizontal extents. Player crouch animation offsets the vertical reference; overlap invokes the common damage response.

units.name: GameplayFrameFinish
units.summary: Complete actor scan, expire invulnerability, copy player coordinates to actor0, lock NMI display work while building OAM/HUD, clear the lock, wait one frame and repeat.

units.name: DamagePlayer
units.summary: Ignore damage during transition, recovery, protection or demo state. Otherwise set a60-frame recovery period, clear movement and start upward knockback with sound21h.

units.name: ActorTemporaryProtectionGate
units.summary: Track a special type36h count outside the excluded map page. If the scene protection timer is active, set actor flagbit0, discard this helper's caller return and leave the actor handler early. Otherwise clear bit0 and allow ordinary handler execution. This stack contract applies only to compatible actor handlers.

units.name: OpenStatusMenu
units.summary: Blank display, save CHR selections, configure menu mode and call the scene-bank5 status entry. Restore saved CHR choices from the stack, rebuild fine-origin map strips and restore display/palette.

units.name: RestoreStatusMenuDisplay
units.summary: Recover saved CHR choices from the stack, rebuild map alignment and restore palette/display. If returning to the hub, refresh the saved NPC palette triple. The menu's caller supplies the two stacked CHR bytes in the expected order.

units.name: RebuildMapAtFineOrigin
units.summary: Choose the nearest row transition from the fine vertical coordinate, then rebuild staged map cells and PPU strips in the matching direction. Clear streaming/exclusion flags and refresh scroll deltas. The four directional table fields retain physical bank identity through the mapper service.

units.name: CheckStartService
units.summary: Newly pressed START bit10h invokes the bank5 service entry. Input semantics follow the serial controller bit order; this is the status/menu service used by saved scenarios.

units.name: RenderHud
units.summary: In scene4 draw fixed icon sprites and convert inventory count into decimal tens/ones. Other scenes draw life icons only when enabled by a scene table, then update the timer.

units.name: LoseLife
units.summary: Unless the transition latch is active, decrement saved lives. Zero enters terminal-title presentation; nonzero selects the scene failure/restart message through the common fade transition.

units.name: FailureTransition
units.summary: Select fade type7 and enter the common failure presentation. The scene restart uses saved state. Positive decremented lives return through the recovered hub continuation; zero enters terminal-title presentation.

units.name: LifeLossOrFinalTitle
units.summary: Stop the current sound and decrement lives. When no lives remain, fade and display the terminal title panel; wait up to240 serviced frames or a fresh START press, then soft-restart after signature invalidation. The alternate path selects the scene restart presentation.

units.name: TickDecimalTimer
units.summary: Pause during demo, transitions or menu states. For supported scene indices divide frames by60, decrement three decimal digits with borrow and trigger timeout when exhausted. Queue a warning sound at the020 threshold.

units.name: TerminalContactTransition
units.summary: Start the shared completion presentation with sound changes and one-time saved scene bookkeeping, then select a message and clear pending PPU work before fade.

units.name: AwardSceneCompletion
units.summary: Stop scene sound and award progress once per saved scene record. Choose the completion message from the record's low-bit category, then enter the common transition with PPU pending work cleared. The award helper sets saved bitsC0h so repeated entry does not award again.

units.name: AwardKeyOnce
units.summary: If scene record bit6 is clear, use bit0 to select one of two saved counters, increment it and mark the scene record withC0h. The caller supplies a valid scene index; these counters include the key progression but the alternate counter meaning is unresolved.

units.name: BankFiveSceneService
units.summary: Select logical bank5, call its800Ch entry and restore the remembered bank. Effective physical PRG context must follow mapper state; CPU800Ch alone does not identify storage.

units.name: DisplayAnimationService
units.summary: Switch to scene bank5, call its animation-reset entry and restore the previous PRG selection.

units.name: DisplayAnimationAdvanceService
units.summary: Switch to scene bank5, call its animation-advance entry and restore the prior PRG selection.

units.name: UpdateRandomState
units.summary: Feed back XOR of bit1 from adjacent state bytes through a four-byte rotate chain, then add distinct odd increments to all four bytes. This is deterministic pseudo-random state, not external entropy.

units.name: ResetFixedBank15
units.summary: Disable interrupts, issue the MMC1 reset write and jump to fixed hardware/scheduler startup. This mapper reset restores the supported startup context.

units.name: INES_Header
units.summary: iNES header: mapper1,128KiB PRG and128KiB CHR, no trainer. Header bytes remain exact.

units.name: SoundControlTargets
units.summary: Eight little-endian handler addresses for the low three global command bits. Inline dispatch removes its return address; these words are payload, not fallthrough instructions.

units.name: SoundChannelFieldTargets
units.summary: Five little-endian field-setter targets for packed channel commands. Only the supported five command bits have valid entries; higher mask bits are not validated.

units.name: SoundEffectCommandTargets
units.summary: Twenty-five little-endian effect command targets. The decoder permits a wider five-bit value, but values25..31 have no established entry contract.

units.name: SoundShortDurations
units.summary: Seven short-duration values selected by packed note classes1..7 after subtracting one. Alternate timing mode uses this table instead of the ordinary duration table.

units.name: SoundDurations
units.summary: Seven ordinary packed-note duration values; class zero is handled separately by the interpreter.

units.name: SoundRelativeNotes
units.summary: Eight signed relative-note adjustments selected by the low three command bits.

units.name: SoundEnvelopeStateTargets
units.summary: Five envelope state targets: initialize, attack, decay, sustain/release handling and completion. Corrupt states beyond the monotone supported state sequence are not validated.

units.name: SoundEnvelopeRates
units.summary: Thirty-two envelope step values. Instrument attack/decay/release fields index this curve; these are amplitude rates rather than CPU targets.

units.name: SoundPitchThresholds
units.summary: Eight quantized pitch thresholds used by the portamento calculation. The final two overlap the nominal period base but are outside the nonzero note-period access domain.

units.name: SoundNotePeriods
units.summary: Quantized sixteen-bit tone periods accessed through overlapping low/high bases. Nonzero notes are clamped below60h and incremented before doubling; the declared physical interval preserves the reviewed exact boundary. No original tuning-system formula is asserted.

units.name: SoundSequenceCount
units.summary: Positive sequence count64, used to wrap ordinary sound requests before indexing the pointer list.

units.name: SoundInstrumentBase
units.summary: Big-endian CPU base pointer to eight-byte instrument records; this byte order differs from ordinary little-endian 6502 pointers.

units.name: SoundSequencePointers
units.summary: Sixty-four high/low CPU pointer pairs for music/effect initialization headers. Request wrapping bounds the index; sequence identity and natural selection of every request remain unknown.

units.name: SoundInstrumentRecords
units.summary: Forty-seven eight-byte instrument records. Consumers use envelope rate/sustain fields, volume/duty, modulation and control flags. Record indexing multiplies by eight; bytes are shared by music and effects. Original instrument names are unknown.

units.name: SoundBytecodeCollection
units.summary: Sound initialization headers and interpreter bytecode, with event masks, packed note/duration values and effect command operands. Initialization headers hold four big-endian channel pointers; effect substreams use their own command/stop grammar. Structurally parsed streams do not prove natural playback of every tune. Small disconnected stop/tail records retain generic data meaning.

units.name: PaletteStreamPointerLo
units.summary: Low bytes of104 palette-stream CPU pointers, paired by index with the high-byte plane. Palette selectors require the supported index domain.

units.name: PalettePointerPadding
units.summary: Eight zero bytes between independently bounded pointer planes. No authored fill purpose is known.

units.name: PaletteStreamPointerHi
units.summary: High bytes of104 palette-stream CPU pointers. The pointed records begin with a RAM palette destination and end at a negative byte.

units.name: PaletteStreams
units.summary: Palette records: initial destination index followed by nonnegative NES palette bytes and a negative terminator. The loader may mask four-color groups before marking upload pending; palette names remain unknown.

units.name: MapQuadrantIds_type4
units.summary: Map quadrant dictionary fragment. Each nine-bit block definition selects four tile ids using index*4+quadrant. The complete dictionary has512 definitions; generic repeated-byte fragments may split the physical source without changing the shared layout. Type and effective bank select the dictionary.

units.name: MapQuadrantTiles_type4
units.summary: Map tile-plane fragment. Four256-byte planes map a tile id to its2x2 CHR tile quadrants. The strip builders select the page by map type and increment its high byte between planes.

units.name: MapPropertyBytes_type4
units.summary: Map property-plane fragment indexed by tile id. Upper six bits encode collision/property class; low two bits select the attribute palette. Exact class names remain local to collision consumers.

units.name: MapQuadrantIds_type5
units.summary: Map quadrant dictionary fragment. Each nine-bit block definition selects four tile ids using index*4+quadrant. The complete dictionary has512 definitions; generic repeated-byte fragments may split the physical source without changing the shared layout. Type and effective bank select the dictionary.

units.name: MapQuadrantTiles_type5
units.summary: Map tile-plane fragment. Four256-byte planes map a tile id to its2x2 CHR tile quadrants. The strip builders select the page by map type and increment its high byte between planes.

units.name: MapPropertyBytes_type5
units.summary: Map property-plane fragment indexed by tile id. Upper six bits encode collision/property class; low two bits select the attribute palette. Exact class names remain local to collision consumers.

units.name: TextPointerLo
units.summary: Low-byte plane of text stream pointers, paired with the high plane under logical bank1. Text ids can contain a high-byte component; these are CPU aliases rather than physical file positions.

units.name: TextPointerHi
units.summary: High-byte plane paired with the text-id low-pointer plane. Consumers interpret the pointed text bytecode and its explicit escape controls.

units.name: MapBlockRecords
units.summary: Fragment of the227-record map block collection. Each72-byte record contains64 low-byte quadrant-definition indices and eight packed high-bit row bytes, selecting nine-bit definitions. The resolver selects logical bank2 for these records; this is not an array of CPU instruction targets.

units.name: MapQuadrantIds_type0
units.summary: Map quadrant dictionary fragment. Each nine-bit block definition selects four tile ids using index*4+quadrant. The complete dictionary has512 definitions; generic repeated-byte fragments may split the physical source without changing the shared layout. Type and effective bank select the dictionary.

units.name: MapQuadrantTiles_type0
units.summary: Map tile-plane fragment. Four256-byte planes map a tile id to its2x2 CHR tile quadrants. The strip builders select the page by map type and increment its high byte between planes.

units.name: MapPropertyBytes_type0
units.summary: Map property-plane fragment indexed by tile id. Upper six bits encode collision/property class; low two bits select the attribute palette. Exact class names remain local to collision consumers.

units.summary: Map quadrant dictionary fragment. Each nine-bit block definition selects four tile ids using index*4+quadrant. The complete dictionary has512 definitions; generic repeated-byte fragments may split the physical source without changing the shared layout. Type and effective bank select the dictionary.

units.summary: Map tile-plane fragment. Four256-byte planes map a tile id to its2x2 CHR tile quadrants. The strip builders select the page by map type and increment its high byte between planes.

units.name: MapPropertyBytes_type1
units.summary: Map property-plane fragment indexed by tile id. Upper six bits encode collision/property class; low two bits select the attribute palette. Exact class names remain local to collision consumers.

units.summary: Map quadrant dictionary fragment. Each nine-bit block definition selects four tile ids using index*4+quadrant. The complete dictionary has512 definitions; generic repeated-byte fragments may split the physical source without changing the shared layout. Type and effective bank select the dictionary.

units.name: MapQuadrantTiles_type2
units.summary: Map tile-plane fragment. Four256-byte planes map a tile id to its2x2 CHR tile quadrants. The strip builders select the page by map type and increment its high byte between planes.

units.name: MapPropertyBytes_type2
units.summary: Map property-plane fragment indexed by tile id. Upper six bits encode collision/property class; low two bits select the attribute palette. Exact class names remain local to collision consumers.

units.summary: Map quadrant dictionary fragment. Each nine-bit block definition selects four tile ids using index*4+quadrant. The complete dictionary has512 definitions; generic repeated-byte fragments may split the physical source without changing the shared layout. Type and effective bank select the dictionary.

units.name: MapQuadrantTiles_type3
units.summary: Map tile-plane fragment. Four256-byte planes map a tile id to its2x2 CHR tile quadrants. The strip builders select the page by map type and increment its high byte between planes.

units.name: MapPropertyBytes_type3
units.summary: Map property-plane fragment indexed by tile id. Upper six bits encode collision/property class; low two bits select the attribute palette. Exact class names remain local to collision consumers.

units.name: MapLayoutRows
units.summary: Map layout rows consumed by the map-type/page lookup. Entries select block records under the separately chosen data bank; physical fragments share the reviewed bounded layout.

units.name: TextWordPointerLo
units.summary: Split dictionary pointer plane for encoded words. The expansion helper temporarily selects logical bank3 and copies glyph bytes through FFh.

units.name: SpriteFramePointerLo
units.summary: Split low-byte pointer plane for composite sprite frames in logical bank4. Frame records select relative coordinate data and tile/attribute pairs.

units.name: SpriteFramePointerHi
units.summary: High-byte plane paired with sprite frame ids. A valid positive-count frame is required; pointer-like values alone do not prove a drawable frame.

units.name: SpriteCoordinatesPointerLo
units.summary: Low-byte plane of relative-coordinate pointers used by sprite frame records. Coordinates are signed screen offsets, not world positions.

units.name: SpriteCoordinatesPointerHi
units.summary: High-byte plane paired with the coordinate record selector.

units.name: ActorAnimationPointerLo
units.summary: Low-byte plane for actor animation programs; paired by animation id with the high-byte table.

units.name: ActorAnimationPointerHi
units.summary: High-byte animation pointer plane. Programs supply frame ids and timing/control bytes to the actor renderer.

units.name: LaterSpriteFramePointerLo
units.summary: Additional frame pointer low-byte plane selected by the renderer's frame-id domain.

units.name: LaterSpriteFramePointerHi
units.summary: Additional frame pointer high-byte plane paired by frame id.

units.name: ActorInitialPointerLo
units.summary: Split initializer pointer planes indexed by actor type. Records begin with a field count and feed parallel actor RAM arrays spaced16 bytes apart.

units.name: ActorSpriteFrameRecords
units.summary: Composite frame records: count-minus-one byte, coordinate selector and tile/attribute pairs. The renderer emits header+1 sprites, unlike the visible-count screen-row format. Coordinate selector plus flip chooses a separate signed-pair record. Not every frame/flip combination has a validated coordinate pointer.

units.name: ActorCoordinateRecords
units.summary: Signed relative Y/X coordinate pairs used by composite frames. Shared records can be referenced by several animations; no exact sprite identity or artwork name is inferred.

units.name: ActorAnimationRecords
units.summary: Animation records: inclusive final frame index, frame delay and frame-id bytes0..header. The renderer advances per-actor frame/delay state and loops after that inclusive limit; exact animation meanings remain actor-specific.

units.name: ActorInitialFieldRecords
units.summary: Count-prefixed initial actor fields, copied into parallel sixteen-slot RAM arrays. Field count controls the write extent; positions and spawn linkage may be supplied later by the spawner.

units.name: MapQuadrantIds_type6
units.summary: Map quadrant dictionary fragment. Each nine-bit block definition selects four tile ids using index*4+quadrant. The complete dictionary has512 definitions; generic repeated-byte fragments may split the physical source without changing the shared layout. Type and effective bank select the dictionary.

units.summary: Map tile-plane fragment. Four256-byte planes map a tile id to its2x2 CHR tile quadrants. The strip builders select the page by map type and increment its high byte between planes.

units.name: MapPropertyBytes_type6
units.summary: Map property-plane fragment indexed by tile id. Upper six bits encode collision/property class; low two bits select the attribute palette. Exact class names remain local to collision consumers.

units.name: TitleChoicePpuPrograms
units.summary: Two complete PPU literal/repeat-compatible programs, each two address/count/tile records plusFF.

units.name: SceneChrLower
units.summary: Parallel scene metadata field ChrLower. Scene index selects this field alongside CHR, world origin, player position, mode, sound and decimal timer fields. Sixteen scenes are represented; timer-digit fields use the supported eight-entry subset.

units.name: SceneChrUpper
units.summary: Parallel scene metadata field ChrUpper. Scene index selects this field alongside CHR, world origin, player position, mode, sound and decimal timer fields. Sixteen scenes are represented; timer-digit fields use the supported eight-entry subset.
